description: This file contains functions to parse LINE-specific directives embedded in text messages, extracting structured data and generating various message templates and control cards for LINE platform integration.

methods.name: parseLineDirectives
methods.description: Parses LINE-specific directives from input text, extracting options like quick replies, location, confirm dialogs, buttons, media players, events, agendas, devices, and Apple TV remote controls, and updates the payload accordingly.

methods.name: hasLineDirectives
methods.description: Checks if the input text contains any LINE-specific directive patterns.
